# Neovim configuration

Declarative [nixvim](https://github.com/nix-community/nixvim) setup.
Leader key: `<Space>` · Colorscheme: `tokyonight` (night)

## Keymaps

| Key | Mode | Description | Action |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `<Esc>` | normal |  | `<cmd>nohlsearch<CR>` |
| `<C-h>` | normal | Move focus left | `<C-w><C-h>` |
| `<C-l>` | normal | Move focus right | `<C-w><C-l>` |
| `<C-j>` | normal | Move focus down | `<C-w><C-j>` |
| `<C-k>` | normal | Move focus up | `<C-w><C-k>` |
| `<leader>q` | normal | Quickfix list | `<cmd>lua vim.diagnostic.setloclist()<CR>` |
| `<Esc><Esc>` | terminal | Exit terminal mode | `<C-\><C-n>` |
| `cd` | normal | Find and replace word | `:%s/\<<C-r><C-w>\>/<C-r><C-w>/gI<Left><Left><Left>` |
| `<leader>f` | normal | Format buffer | `<cmd>lua require('conform').format({ async = true, lsp_fallback = true })<CR>` |
| `\` | normal | Toggle Neo-tree | `<cmd>Neotree toggle<CR>` |
| `<leader>xx` | normal | Diagnostics | `<cmd>Trouble diagnostics toggle<CR>` |
| `<leader>xX` | normal | Buffer Diagnostics | `<cmd>Trouble diagnostics toggle filter.buf=0<CR>` |
| `<leader>cs` | normal | Symbols | `<cmd>Trouble symbols toggle focus=false<CR>` |
| `<leader>cl` | normal | LSP refs | `<cmd>Trouble lsp toggle focus=false win.position=right<CR>` |
| `<leader>xL` | normal | Location List | `<cmd>Trouble loclist toggle<CR>` |
| `<leader>xQ` | normal | Quickfix List | `<cmd>Trouble qflist toggle<CR>` |
| `<leader>a` | normal | Harpoon add | *(lua)* |
| `<leader>e` | normal | Harpoon menu | *(lua)* |
| `<leader>1` | normal | Harpoon 1 | *(lua)* |
| `<leader>2` | normal | Harpoon 2 | *(lua)* |
| `<leader>3` | normal | Harpoon 3 | *(lua)* |
| `<leader>4` | normal | Harpoon 4 | *(lua)* |
| `<C-S-P>` | normal | Harpoon prev | *(lua)* |
| `<C-S-N>` | normal | Harpoon next | *(lua)* |
| `<Leader>;` | normal | Pick symbols | *(lua)* |
| `[;` | normal | Context start | *(lua)* |
| `];` | normal | Next context | *(lua)* |
